headline: United States tells citizens to leave Iran and warns hostilities could escalate fast
label: BREAKING
caption:
The United States government has issued a warning telling all its citizens to leave Iran immediately. 🚨

According to Euronews, officials warn that regional hostilities could escalate very fast and put American lives at risk.

The urgent travel advisory comes amid rising tensions in the Middle East and growing concerns over security.
